environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'media-processing' with standard nginx ingress controller. Ingress resource configured with TLS termination only (no client cert requirement). Pod service exposed via ClusterIP with ingress path /grpc/* forwarding to port 8443. Pod runs as root with hostPath volume mount at /var/data. No NetworkPolicy restricting ingress sources. Ingress annotation: nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/backend-protocol: GRPCS
